baseline_construction_method.value: Potential influence variables were normalised and screened with discriminant function analysis to identify key influence variables. An EPI regression model against the discriminant function was then used to calculate a baseline adjusted to actual external influence conditions.
evidence_quote: In our case a Discriminant Function Analysis (DFA) technique is selected to extract key inﬂuence variables (KIVs) from PIV and model EPI against these variables.

In the last step of the modeling phase, a regression model of EPI versus discriminant function is obtained. This model condenses the dependence of energy performance on KIV and will be used to obtain EPI baseline.
